payload.body: Sub-split into FR-118 (async seam + SQLite adapter, SQLite-only), FR-119 (PG core data plane), FR-120 (PG identity), FR-121 (PG tenant/admin/runtime), FR-122 (PG blobs). FR-119–122 blocked_by FR-118. Created under FR-4 since Scope nests stories only under epics. Starting FR-118.
